method: Actual routeJourney GET /api/restaurants on freshly migrated in-memory database, 20 menu items per restaurant, zero orders, one request at a time; no HTTP transport, auth, remote provider or production data; 30s per child route budget.
limitations: Single synthetic host and tiny menus; these are route samples, not a capacity/SLO benchmark.
In-memory SQLite excludes disk contention and order history.
No claimed p95/p99 from this small sample.
Independent agents and audit checks may consume host resources; rerun on controlled staging hardware for sizing.
